column1: #mapping_set_description: 'Header lines of Ensembl genomic DNA FASTA files. Release FTP style: ''>ID SEQTYPE:COORDSYS COORDSYS:VERSION:NAME:START:END:STRAND EXC'' (EXC is ''REF'' or empty with a trailing space). ensemblorganisms FTP style: ''>ID SEQTYPE:COORDSYS VERSION:NAME:START:END:STRAND'' (no coord system inside the location; non-reference scaffolds end with a trailing space). The format is positional; the field paths are names chosen here, following the Ensembl Slice name parts.'

column9: The location always spans the whole sequence (start 1), so end is the length.
Value transformed (map). Lossy: The release FTP writes dna, the new FTP unmasked; both become not-masked and are written back as dna.
chromosome or scaffold: Ensembl's coordinate system.
REF, or empty for alt and patch scaffolds; does not tell alt from patch.
